name: Another Side of Machi Tsuu
original_name: アナザーサイドオブ街痛
source:
Before becoming a detective, Yas was one of the young people known as "freeters." He, too, felt a certain sense of guilt about it. Today, once again, he finished a long day of work at the factory and was on his way home. The same kind of day was waiting for him once the new week began...

[Translated From Official Website]
translation:
在成为侦探之前，亚斯是被称为“自由者”的年轻人之一。对此，他也感到了一丝愧疚。今天，他又结束了一天在工厂的工作，踏上回家的路。新的一周开始后，同样的一天也在等待着他……

【译自官网】
